parameters.name: AddressIPVersion
parameters.description:
The protocol version. Valid values:

- **ipv4** (default): IPv4.

- **DualStack**: dual-stack.

parameters.name: AnyPortEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable all-port forwarding. Valid values:

- **true**: enabled.

- **false** (default): disabled.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: ConnectionDrainEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable connection draining. Valid values:

- **true**: enabled.

- **false** (default): disabled.

parameters.name: ConnectionDrainTimeout
parameters.description:
The timeout period of connection draining. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: **0** to **900**.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
- **true**: performs a dry run without creating the server group. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
- **false** (default): sends the request. After the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed.

parameters.name: IpVersionAffinityMode
parameters.description:
The traffic scheduling policy in dual-stack mode:

- NonAffinity (default): non-affinity mode. Traffic is forwarded to healthy backend servers based on the scheduling algorithm, regardless of the IP protocol version of the source.
- Affinity: affinity mode. Traffic is forwarded based on the IP protocol version of the request source. IPv4 requests are forwarded only to IPv4 backend servers, and IPv6 requests are forwarded only to IPv6 backend servers.
> This parameter takes effect only when **AddressIPVersion** is set to **DualStack**.

parameters.name: PreserveClientIpEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable client IP preservation. Valid values:

- **true** (default): enabled.
- **false**: disabled.


> 
> If **Protocol** is set to **TCP** and this parameter is set to **true**, the server group cannot be associated with **TCPSSL** listeners.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description:
The communication protocol used to forward requests to the backend servers. Valid values:

- **TCP** (default)
- **UDP**
- **TCP_UDP**
> 
> - If this parameter is set to **UDP**, the server group can be associated only with **UDP** listeners.
> - If this parameter is set to **TCP** and **PreserveClientIpEnabled** is set to **true**, the server group can be associated only with **TCP** listeners.
> - If this parameter is set to **TCP** and **PreserveClientIpEnabled** is set to **false**, the server group can be associated with **TCPSSL** listeners and **TCP** listeners.
> - If this parameter is set to **TCP_UDP**, the server group can be associated with **TCP** listeners and **UDP** listeners.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~443657~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the server group belongs.

parameters.name: Scheduler
parameters.description:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:

- **Wrr** (default): weighted round-robin. Backend servers with higher weights are polled more frequently.

- **Wlc**: weighted least connections. In addition to the weight of each backend server, the actual load (number of connections) is also considered. When the weights are the same, backend servers with fewer current connections are polled more frequently.

- **rr**: round-robin. Requests are distributed to backend servers in sequence.

- **sch**: source IP hashing. Requests from the same source IP address are distributed to the same backend server.

- **tch**: four-element hashing. Consistent hashing based on four elements (source IP address, destination IP address, source port, and destination port). The same stream is distributed to the same backend server.

- **qch**: QUIC ID hashing. Requests with the same QUIC ID are distributed to the same backend server.

>  QUIC ID hashing is supported only when the backend protocol is UDP.

parameters.name: ServerGroupName
parameters.description:
The name of the server group.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and must start with an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, or Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: ServerGroupType
parameters.description:
The type of the server group. Valid values:

- **Instance** (default): server type. This type of server group supports adding instances of the **Ecs**, **Eni**, and **Eci** types.

- **Ip**: IP address type. This type of server group supports directly adding backend servers by IP address.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. Valid characters include letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), forward slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@).

You can add up to 20 tags in each call.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. Valid characters include letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), colons (:), forward slashes (/), equal signs (=), plus signs (+), hyphens (-), and at signs (@).

You can add up to 20 tags in each call.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the server group belongs.

> If **ServerGroupType** is set to **Instance**, only servers in this VPC can be added to the server group.
